title: UltraDiff: Transferring High-Fidelity Priors to Compressed Latent Spaces for High-Resolution Image Generation
title_zh: UltraDiff：将高保真先验知识迁移至压缩潜在空间，以实现高分辨率图像生成

paragraphs.en: UltraDiff 是一个将高保真先验知识迁移至压缩潜在空间的框架，以实现高分辨率图像生成。 High-resolution synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) faces a fundamental trade-off between computational cost and generative fidelity. This trade off is largely governed by the latent compression factor f (e.g. f8 denotes f=8 and f32 f=32). While aggressive compression (f32) significantly improves efficiency, it suffers from severe information loss and ambiguity compared to standard f8 models. We propose UltraDiff, a framework that reformulates this challenge as joint latent diffusion learning followed by marginal score distillation. We introduce MixTeacher, a dual branch DiT that models the joint f8-f32 distribution, utilizing shared attention to resolve the ambiguity of the compressed space with high fidelity f8 priors. Crucially, we propose vector field distillation in the native f32 space. Theoretically, this compels the student to learn the conditional expectation of the teacher trajectory, effectively filtering out compression artifacts. Across the evaluated 1K to 4K settings, UltraDiff approaches f8 level quality while preserving f32 efficiency. With 20 sampling steps on a single A100 GPU, it generates a 2K image in 6.2 seconds over 40 times faster than our f8 baseline.
paragraphs.zh: UltraDiff 是一个将高保真先验知识迁移至压缩潜在空间以实现高分辨率图像生成的框架。使用潜在扩散模型（LDM）进行高分辨率合成时，计算成本与生成保真度之间存在根本性的权衡。 这一权衡主要由潜在压缩因子 f 决定（例如 f8 表示 f=8，f32 表示 f=32）。 虽然激进压缩（f32）显著提升了效率，但与标准的 f8 模型相比，它存在严重的信息丢失和歧义问题。 我们提出 UltraDiff，一个将该挑战重新表述为联合潜在扩散学习加边缘分数蒸馏的框架。 我们引入 MixTeacher，一个建模 f8-f32 联合分布的双分支 DiT，利用共享注意力以高保真度的 f8 先验来解决压缩空间的歧义问题。 关键在于，我们提出在原生 f32 空间中进行向量场蒸馏。 从理论上讲，这促使学生模型学习教师轨迹的条件期望，从而有效滤除压缩伪影。 在所评估的 1K 至 4K 设置中，UltraDiff 在保持 f32 效率的同时，达到了接近 f8 的质量水平。 在单张 A100 GPU 上以 20 个采样步数生成一张 2K 图像仅需 6.2 秒，比我们的 f8 基线快 40 多倍。
